reviews.rationale: The company disclosures establish deliberate omission of production safeguards to assess maximal cyber capability, supporting Marcus's qualified description. They are not independent findings. Ordinary deployment breach probability remains unknown, but the claim and fair contract do not require it. No material counterevidence is supplied.
